ephemeris.source: NASA/JPL Horizons, geometric vectors, ICRF, UTC

methodology: This is a physical reconstruction constrained by rounded NASA mission-report states; no continuous spacecraft telemetry is bundled.
Unpowered legs: DOP853 Earth–Moon–Sun point-mass gravity, shooting fit to endpoint positions.

Powered legs: controlled quintic boundary reconstruction. Launch, landing and ascent enforce a nonnegative radial altitude profile; entry uses a monotonically damped radial profile fitted to entry vertical speed and splashdown. Throttle, aerodynamic lift, bank angle and guidance histories are not recovered.

Lunar velocity directions are solved from position endpoints with a retrograde initial guess; the printed heading convention is not treated as modern Moon-ME local north. Orbital periods, planes and speeds follow the constrained gravity solution. Gravity harmonics, solar radiation pressure and atmospheric drag outside reconstructed entry are not resolved.
Old lunar map-frame alignment and Earth ellipsoid substitution are documented in trajectory-anchors.json.
Scene distances and radii retain the atlas display scale; body-frame coordinates use NASA SPICE orientations.
No long-term location is assigned to the discarded ascent stage.
